subject: Coaching T6: Full Arena Mode WCAG 2.1 AA audit -- 7 failures, design rules, fix specs
body:
COACHING SUBMISSION T6: Full Arena Mode WCAG 2.1 AA Color Contrast Audit
Exhaustive audit -- every element, every foreground/background combination.

---

ARENA MODE TOKEN VALUES (body.arena-mode in shared/styles.css)
--bg-page: #0A0E1A | --bg-card: #141B2D | --bg-input: #1A2240
--text-primary: #E0E4EB | --text-secondary: #8B92A8 | --text-inverse: #0A0E1A
--accent-red: #E8334A | --accent-red-hover: #FF4D63
--accent-blue: #4A72E8 | --accent-blue-hover: #6B8FFF | --accent-navy: #A0B8E8
--border-default: #2A3352 | --border-focus: #4A72E8
--color-correct: #2ECC71 | --color-correct-bg: #0D2818
--color-incorrect: #FF3A55 | --color-incorrect-bg: #2D0A12
--color-warning: #F5C842 | --color-warning-bg: #2D2408

---

AUDIT TABLE (WCAG 2.1 AA: normal text 4.5:1, large text/UI 3:1)

TEXT COLORS ON BACKGROUNDS
PASS 15.10:1 | text-primary #E0E4EB on bg-page #0A0E1A      | large + normal
PASS 13.45:1 | text-primary #E0E4EB on bg-card #141B2D      | large + normal
PASS 12.23:1 | text-primary #E0E4EB on bg-input #1A2240     | large + normal
PASS  6.21:1 | text-secondary #8B92A8 on bg-page            | large + normal
PASS  5.53:1 | text-secondary #8B92A8 on bg-card            | large + normal
PASS  5.03:1 | text-secondary #8B92A8 on bg-input           | large + normal

ACCENT COLORS AS TEXT (links, headings, labels)
FAIL  3.97:1 | accent-blue #4A72E8 as text on bg-card       | fails 4.5:1 -- link/heading color
FAIL  4.46:1 | accent-blue #4A72E8 as text on bg-page       | fails 4.5:1 -- close but fail
FAIL  4.09:1 | accent-red #E8334A as text on bg-card        | fails 4.5:1 -- error label color
PASS  4.59:1 | accent-red #E8334A as text on bg-page        | barely passes normal text
PASS  8.59:1 | accent-navy #A0B8E8 as text on bg-card       | strong pass -- safe text color
PASS  5.72:1 | accent-blue-hover #6B8FFF as text on bg-card | PASS -- use for links, not accent-blue
PASS  5.30:1 | accent-red-hover #FF4D63 as text on bg-card  | PASS -- use for red text/links

BUTTONS: TEXT ON COLORED BUTTON BACKGROUNDS
FAIL  4.46:1 | text-inverse #0A0E1A on accent-blue button   | dark text on blue -- FAIL
FAIL  3.39:1 | text-primary #E0E4EB on accent-blue button   | white text on blue -- FAIL
PASS  4.59:1 | text-inverse #0A0E1A on accent-red button    | dark text on red -- barely PASS
PASS  5.72:1 | text-inverse #0A0E1A on #5B85FF (lighter blue) | PASS -- see fix below

BORDER / UI COMPONENTS (need 3:1)
PASS  3.97:1 | accent-blue border on bg-card               | focus ring, accent border
PASS  3.61:1 | accent-blue border on bg-input              | input focus ring
FAIL  1.38:1 | border-default on bg-card                   | card borders -- FAIL (already filed to GA)
FAIL  1.26:1 | border-default on bg-input                  | input borders -- FAIL (already filed to GA)

FEEDBACK STATES (correct/incorrect/warning)
PASS  7.49:1 | correct green #2ECC71 on correct-bg #0D2818
PASS  8.16:1 | correct green #2ECC71 on bg-card
PASS  5.15:1 | incorrect red #FF3A55 on incorrect-bg #2D0A12
PASS  4.89:1 | incorrect red #FF3A55 on bg-card
PASS  9.67:1 | warning #F5C842 on warning-bg #2D2408
PASS 10.80:1 | warning #F5C842 on bg-card

HOVER STATES (UI, need 3:1 minimum)
PASS  5.30:1 | accent-red-hover #FF4D63 on bg-card
PASS  5.72:1 | accent-blue-hover #6B8FFF on bg-card

---

SUMMARY: 7 FAILURES

HIGH PRIORITY (affects button CTA readability):
1. Blue button text-inverse (#0A0E1A on #4A72E8) = 4.46:1 FAIL
   Fix: Use #5B85FF as arena button bg (5.72:1 with dark text, stays in blue family)
   Alt: Use white text (#E0E4EB) with #3E5AD4 button bg (4.55:1 with white)

MEDIUM PRIORITY (accent as text color):
2. #4A72E8 as text on bg-card = 3.97:1 FAIL -- swap for #6B8FFF (5.72:1 PASS)
3. #4A72E8 as text on bg-page = 4.46:1 FAIL -- swap for #6B8FFF
4. #E8334A as text on bg-card = 4.09:1 FAIL -- swap for #FF4D63 (5.30:1 PASS)

ALREADY FILED TO GA:
5. border-default #2A3352 on bg-input = 1.26:1 FAIL (input borders spec 20260222-1655)
6. border-default #2A3352 on bg-card = 1.38:1 FAIL (same spec)

SAFE DESIGN RULES DERIVED FROM THIS AUDIT:
- accent-blue (#4A72E8) = borders/icons ONLY. Never text.
- accent-blue-hover (#6B8FFF) = text links, active labels. SAFE.
- accent-navy (#A0B8E8) = heading colors, callout text. SAFE (8.59:1).
- accent-red (#E8334A) = UI components, buttons. Not text on card.
- accent-red-hover (#FF4D63) = red text/labels. SAFE.
- Blue buttons in arena mode: use #5B85FF bg + dark text (#0A0E1A) -- or redesign as outlined.
